Quick triage notes (initial):
- I looked at the grafana snapshots Jordan sent and our internal traces for the time window. We see a pattern of short-lived queueing at the frontend proxy layer that lines up with periodic KV cache misses and a bursty arrival pattern from BrightPay's client (their payroll run is highly parallel).
- Root causes likely contributing:
  * client parallelism occasionally overruns our soft concurrency caps, causing request queuing in the proxy (requests sit in per-shard queues instead of streaming to GPU).
  * large KV cache evictions during peak cause a transient CPU spike on the worker host, delaying token throughput for a small fraction of requests.
  * the worker autoscaler didn't spin up extra capacity fast enough for the burst profile — autoscale thresholds are tuned for sustained load, not short 10-20 minute bursts.

Immediate mitigation (recommendation):
1) Client-side: cap concurrency to 4 per client process (Jordan indicated they can do this). This will drastically reduce queuing at the proxy.
2) Server-side temporary: raise per-worker concurrency cap from 64 -> 96 for the BrightPay routing policy and enable a short-term lower threshold for autoscale (scale up faster).
3) Rolling restart of the affected worker shard to free up the KV cache and reclaim memory (schedule at next quiet window, e.g., 01:00 UTC).

I’ve attached a quick Grafana screenshot that shows queue depth and the KV eviction spikes. I’ll follow up with a small playbook for immediate actions.

Commands (ops):
- set-routing-policy brightpay set concurrency_cap=96
- kubectl rollout restart deploy/worker-shard-brightpay -n inference --timeout=10m

Marcus Lin
SRE, Redwood Inference

Team —

Summary for execs (BrightPay DP-3982):
- Impact: intermittent long-tail latency spikes during BrightPay payroll runs (p99.99 up to ~18s historically; recent mitigations reduced to ~2.4s). Affected ~2% of requests in peak windows leading to retry churn and failed payroll batches.
- Cause (probable): client burstiness + per-shard queueing + KV cache eviction spikes + autoscaler response lag.
- Mitigations executed: client concurrency cap (4), temporary per-worker concurrency bump, targeted rolling restart. Observed immediate reduction in failures.
- Requested engineering roadmap items (prioritized):
  1) Add request-size-aware routing / priority for oversized requests (short-term heuristic).
  2) Improve autoscaler for short-burst profiles (reduce cooldown & lower scale-up threshold).
  3) Better tail instrumentation (per-shard queue depth, per-request queue time, p99.999 metrics).

Operational ask: approve up to a single-month credit (customer requested) while we complete the above items and provide a formal RCA. Finance/sales will need the approved range to communicate to BrightPay.

Lauren — please draft the customer note and proposed credit range. Jonas / Rishi — need a go/no-go on the credit and an ETA on the three roadmap items.

Evelyn
